title: salix rigida var. angustata
intro: Salix rigida var. angustata, commonly known as the narrow-leaved willow, is a plant species belonging to the Salicaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help alleviate pain, reduce fever, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Salix rigida var. angustata include its ability to act as an analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salicylic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
